title: Talk to Alexander

nodes.speaker: Alexander
nodes.text: We have never interacted in a non-business environment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We have never interacted in a non-business environment.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, this is my business. Should I direct you to the right department...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, this is my business. Should I direct you to the right department...?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, this is my business. Should I direct you to the right department...?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, this is my business. Should I direct you to the right department...?

nodes.speaker: Alexander
nodes.text: Alright, alright. I didn't come here to waste time. I wanted to talk about the kid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, alright. I didn't come here to waste time. I wanted to talk about the kid.

nodes.speaker: Alexander
nodes.text: Yeah. See, I know what he's going through.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. See, I know what he's going through.

nodes.speaker: Alexander
nodes.text: When we were younger than him, my sis and I got sick.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When we were younger than him, my sis and I got sick.

nodes.speaker: Alexander
nodes.text: Stacks Fever they called it. Tore through the place like wildfire. Killed thousands.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Stacks Fever they called it. Tore through the place like wildfire. Killed thousands.

nodes.speaker: Alexander
nodes.text: Our parents didn't have insurance. Couldn't buy a Lim. But a free clinic doc waived the fee. Saved our lives.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Our parents didn't have insurance. Couldn't buy a Lim. But a free clinic doc waived the fee. Saved our lives.

nodes.speaker: Alexander
nodes.text: Yeah. So, we try to give back where we can. Got 50 Lims for that kid you're trying to save.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. So, we try to give back where we can. Got 50 Lims for that kid you're trying to save.

nodes.speaker: Alexander
nodes.text: Eh, it ain't much, I know. But we owe it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, it ain't much, I know. But we owe it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you do have a moral code.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you do have a moral code.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you do have a moral code.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you do have a moral code.

nodes.speaker: Alexander
nodes.text: Sure. Alexandra sends her greetings. And... I hope the kid makes it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. Alexandra sends her greetings. And... I hope the kid makes it.
